================================================================================
COMPANY OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Infinus is a SAP Gold Partner specializing in SAP Cloud ERP solutions for 
mid-market and enterprise companies across Europe. We help Professional Services 
firms, Retail, Pharma, and Manufacturing companies transform their operations 
with SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

Our team consists of 30+ senior SAP consultants with 10+ years of professional 
experience each. We offer competitive pricing with European quality, operating 
from Serbia in the CET timezone.

================================================================================
CORE SOLUTIONS
================================================================================

## 1. ProjectPulse - SAP Qualified Partner-Packaged Solution
   URL: https://www.infinus.co/projectpulse

   ProjectPulse is our flagship SAP Qualified Partner-Packaged Solution (QPPS) 
   designed specifically for Professional Services firms.

   ### What ProjectPulse Solves:
   - Disconnected project execution, timesheets, and billing systems
   - Late margin and cash visibility (often only at month-end)
   - Multiple "sources of truth" across PM tools, spreadsheets, accounting
   - Billing delays due to missing approvals and unclear invoice readiness
   - Limited WIP/unbilled and profitability visibility by project and customer

   ### ProjectPulse Capabilities:
   - Complete Project-to-Profit flow in one system
   - 7-step process: Setup → Staffing → Execution → Control → Billing → Profitability → Close
   - Real-time margin visibility by project, customer, and service line
   - Invoice readiness signals and billing blocker detection
   - Utilization and billability transparency
   - Embedded analytics, AI, and integrations
   - 4-6 month typical implementation timeline

   ### Industries Ideal for ProjectPulse:
   - Consulting & Advisory firms
   - IT Services & Systems Integration
   - Software Development companies
   - Outsourcing & Nearshoring providers
   - Creative & Digital Agencies
   - Architecture & Design firms
   - Engineering companies
   - Legal firms

   ### Executive Outcomes:
   - CEO: Portfolio visibility, profitability by customer and service line
   - CFO: Faster billing cycles, WIP clarity, cash visibility
   - COO: Utilization transparency, early deviation detection

================================================================================
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

Q: What is ProjectPulse?
A: ProjectPulse is an SAP Qualified Partner-Packaged Solution that connects 
   service delivery, resource planning, billing, and profitability for 
   Professional Services firms in one end-to-end ERP-based flow.

Q: How long does ProjectPulse implementation take?
A: Typically 4-6 months from kickoff to go-live, following five phases: 
   Discover → Fit-to-Standard → Build & Integrate → Test & Train → Go-live & Hypercare.

Q: Is Infinus an official SAP partner?
A: Yes, Infinus is a SAP Gold Partner with certified consultants across 
   SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and various industry solutions.

Q: What regions does Infinus serve?
A: We serve companies throughout Europe, with particular strength in Central 
   and Eastern Europe, DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), and Nordics.

Q: Can Infinus work remotely?
A: Yes, we offer flexible engagement models including fully remote, onsite, 
   or hybrid arrangements based on client preferences.

Q: What SAP solutions does Infinus specialize in?
A: SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public and Private), SAP Business Technology Platform, 
   SAP Business AI, SAP Analytics Cloud, and SAP Business Data Cloud.

Q: How is Infinus different from other SAP partners?
A: We combine senior European expertise with competitive pricing, offering 
   flexible engagement models and deep industry knowledge in Professional 
   Services, Retail, and Manufacturing.
